No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, lucide-react, or web UI components are imported — only React (useCallback/useMemo + type ReactNode), react-native primitives (Alert/Pressable/StyleSheet/View), @tanstack/react-query (useMutation/useQueryClient), the existing native AppText, theme tokens, and the already-ported native devtools (triggerQuickBackup) + client (ApiError). Behavior verified by __tests__/BackupActionsCard.test.tsx (5 tests, real QueryClientProvider + mocked triggerQuickBackup + Alert spy): renders children + run button + manage link; manage link routes to '/backup'; press triggers the mutation + 'Quick backup started' Alert; the button is disabled with the 'Starting…' label while pending; a failed mutation surfaces 'Backup failed: disk full'.
